question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Stationary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fixed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Stationary **means fixed in a station, course, or mode: immobile.

 
 
• Example - *He crashed into the back of a **stationary **vehicle.*
 
 Marked option **Fixed **means not moving or able to be moved from its position.

 
 
• Example - *Guide stars are **fixed **points in space used to keep a telescope in position.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Stationary**' and '**Fixed**' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Paper **means a substance made from wood pulp, rags, straw, or other fibrous material, usually in thin sheets, used to bear writing or printing, for wrapping things, etc.
 
• **Movable **means capable of being moved; not fixed in one place, position, or posture.
 
• **Portable **means that can be moved or carried easily from one place to another.
